# Governance

**← Back to [EAP Home](../README.md)**

---

> The governance section establishes framework, processes, and oversight mechanisms that ensure enterprise architecture decisions align with business objectives, comply with standards, and deliver measurable value to Gainwell and its clients.

---
page_texts.2:
[governance/README.md#governance-overview]

## Governance Overview

<!-- synthesia-video-url: https://share.synthesia.io/c274adf3-cbaa-418b-8f8f-8f775c78c87a | ../assets/images/synthesia/governance-thumbnail.png -->

Enterprise Architecture governance provides the structure and processes to:

- Ensure architectural decisions support business strategy and objectives
- Maintain quality standards and compliance across all architectural work
- Provide clear decision-making authority and accountability
- Enable risk management and issue resolution
- Foster continuous improvement and organizational learning
